Name: Fateful Curse
Base Effect: Opponent rolls 2 dice. They must take the lower roll
Wager Bonus: Opponent must reroll their dice next round
Flavour Text: Twist their fortune, then twist it again.

Name: Loaded Choice
Base Effect: Roll 3 dice this round. Secretly choose 2 to keep and discard the third
Flavour Text: Stack the odds. Hide the truth.

Name: Crippled Chance
Base Effect: Opponent rolls 2 dice but must discard the higher before revealing
Wager Bonus: View the top card of opponent’s deck
Flavour Text: Their best roll never sees the light.

Name: Dice Drain
Base Effect: Opponent rolls 1 fewer die (minimum 1)
Wager Bonus: Opponent reveals 1 random card from hand
Flavour Text: Starve their chances. Watch them scramble.

Name: Blind Gambit
Base Effect: Roll 1 secret die (you do not look). After seeing opponent’s roll, you may replace your roll with it
Wager Bonus: Opponent reveals their wager next round
Flavour Text: Play blind. Strike true.

Name: Phase Disruptor

Flavour Text: Break their rhythm. Rewrite the tempo.

Name: Quick Reflex
Base Effect: If opponent plays no ◖card, play 1 extra ◖ card
Flavour Text: Strike when they hesitate. Move before they blink.

Name: Lunar Precision
Base Effect: If your die is lower than the opponent’s, add +1.
Wager Bonus: If you win the wager, add an extra +1.
Flavour Text: “The moon lifts those who fall behind.”

Name: Star‑Tilt Blessing
Base Effect: If your die is equal to the opponent’s, gain +2.
Wager Bonus: If you lose the wager, you may reroll your die.
Flavour Text: “When stars align, destiny leans your way.”

Name: Fate Lock
Base Effect: Opponent cannot modify their die this round.
Wager Bonus: Opponent reveals the next  ◖card they draw.
Flavour Text: “Some paths close before they’re ever walked.”

Name: Shadow Cut
Base Effect: Reduce opponent’s final total by –1.
Wager Bonus: If you win the wager, reduce by –2 next round.
Flavour Text: “A single snip unravels the strongest thread.”

Name: Moon’s Edge
Base Effect: If your die is odd, gain +1. If even, gain +2.
Wager Bonus: If you would lose the wager, gain +1 regardless.
Flavour Text: “Every number holds its own secret.”

Name: Star Veil
Base Effect: If your die is lower than the opponent’s, draw 1.
Wager Bonus: If you would win the wager, draw 2 instead.
Flavour Text: “The stars reward those who dare.”

Name: Veiled Outcome
Base Effect: If you lose the round, gain +2. (Face‑down.)
Wager Bonus: If you win the wager, gain +1 instead.
Flavour Text: “Some blessings hide behind defeat.”

Name: Twilight Swap

Wager Bonus: If you would lose the wager, this card cannot be blocked.
Flavour Text: “In twilight, even certainty

Name: Lunar Momentum
Base Effect: If you would win this round, gain +1 to your next round’s die.
Flavour Text: “Victory gathers speed like a waxing moon.”

Name: Clockbind
Base Effect: If your die is higher than the opponent’s, they have - 1 next round.
Wager Bonus: If you win the wager, the have -2 instead.
Flavour Text: “Time punishes those who fall behind.”

Name: Moonbind Snare
Base Effect: Next round: If opponent rolls a 6, reduce their die by –2.
Flavour Text: “What they hold back, you pull forward.”

Name: Mirror Hex
Base Effect: Next round: The first negative effect your opponent applies to you is reflected back onto them.
Flavour Text: “The curse returns to the hand that cast it.”

Name: Thread Sever
Base Effect: Next round: If opponent would win the wager, cancel their wager bonus.
Flavour Text: “A single cut can unravel a thread.”

Name: Lunar Backlash
Base Effect: Next round: If opponent reduces your die, reduce theirs by the same amount.
Flavour Text: “Every cut leaves a twin scar.”

Name: Star Glimpse
Base Effect: Next round: If opponent's die matches yours, view their hand.
Flavour Text: “The stars see all.”

Name: Moonshield Reading
Base Effect: Next round: If opponent plays a Disruption card, its effect is prevented.
Flavour Text: “The moon shines through the lies.”

Name: Shared Burden

Flavour Text: “Pain shared is pain returned.”

Name: Twilight Breach
Base Effect: Next round: If you would lose the round, swap your die with the opponent's before totals are final.
Flavour Text: “The moon is a door.”

Name: Clock Snare
Base Effect: Next round: If opponent skips a play, skip again.
Flavour Text: “Time is a thread.”

Name: Echoed Loss

Flavour Text: “Your fall becomes their stumble.”
